brief: Make elicify-vertex work end-to-end (goals + harness). First: align with the operator on requirements for how visible system-prompt injection / steering should be in the OpenCode UI — then implement and prove E2E.

stories.title: Ideate visibility requirements with operator
stories.objective: Discuss and lock written requirements with the user (this operator) on injection/steering visibility: what must stay invisible vs what must appear in chat/UI; when (always / debug only / on gate fire); audience (end user vs operator); channels (chat bubble, status line, debug log, events); non-goals and privacy. Deliverable: a short agreed requirements note the user confirms before any code. Do not implement visibility features until the user signs off on that note.
stories.evidence: Operator interview via question tool (2026-07-24). Answers: audience=both; routine=soft cue on activate; when=activate+gate fire; channel=minimal chat line (reuse compact OpenCode UX patterns); full contract text=on gate block only; stance=gate-visible-only reconciled with activate cue. Requirements written to docs/REQUIREMENTS-INJECTION-VISIBILITY.md — awaiting operator "approved" before G002 code.

stories.title: Implement agreed visibility behavior
stories.objective: Implement only what the signed-off requirements specify (may be zero UI change if user chooses fully invisible). Wire through system.transform and/or gate paths as required; tests + docs.
stories.evidence: Implemented formatActivateCue + chat.message one-shot user-visible line; formatGateContinuationText on session.prompt stop/promise paths; docs USAGE + requirements sign-off; tests 289 green.

stories.title: Prove injection/steering E2E in live OpenCode
stories.objective: With VERTEX_DEBUG and/or the agreed visible cues, demonstrate in a real OpenCode session that activation + inject + (if required) user-visible signals work; capture debug/event evidence.

stories.title: Goals E2E in a project dir
stories.objective: create → next → work → verify → checkpoint → final receipt gate under a writable project path; no root-path failures.

stories.title: Agent + slash UX + stop/promise gates
stories.objective: Agent multi-story guidance and slash templates produce correct tool use; deep unverified edit blocks; docs-only/verified allow; promise-no-act on TODO-later after edits.

stories.title: Final verification
stories.objective: Run the integrated exit proof and checkpoint its observed successful verification receipt.
